map.输入潜在毛租金 GPR、空置率、收账损失率与让利比例，计算有效毛收入（EGI）及: Enter potential gross rent (GPR), vacancy rate, collection loss rate and concession ratio to compute effective gross income (EGI) and each vacancy loss, benchmarked against market vacancy norms.
map.📖 查看「空置损失估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Vacancy Loss Estimator User Guide"
map.空置损失 = 潜在租金 × 空置率: Vacancy loss = potential rent × vacancy rate
map.💡 EGI = GPR − 空置损失 − 收账损失 − 让利损失 + 其他收入；: 💡 EGI = GPR − vacancy loss − collection loss − concession loss + other income; each loss is deducted in order.
map.GPR 为满租状态下的潜在毛租金收入: GPR is the potential gross rent at full occupancy
map.收账损失指已出租但未能收回的租金（坏账）: Collection loss is rent that was let but not collected (bad debt)
map.市场基准为经验值，不同城市/区位差异较大: Market benchmarks are rules of thumb and vary widely by city and location
map.酒店空置率波动大，长期估值建议参考 3–5 年均值: Hotel vacancy swings widely, so long-term valuation should use a 3-5 year average
map.持有型物业测算有效毛收入 EGI 与空置损失。: Compute EGI and vacancy loss for a held property.
map.对比不同业态基准空置率（住宅/办公/商业）。: Compare benchmark vacancy rates across uses (residential / office / retail).
map.优化招租使空置率每降 1% 的年增收。: See the annual gain from cutting vacancy by 1% through better leasing.
map.潜在毛租金 GPR 120 万、办公空置 8% → 空置损失 9.6 万；收缴坏: GPR of 1.2 million yuan with 8% office vacancy gives a vacancy loss of 96,000; bad debt at 2% gives 22,100 and rent-free concessions at 3% give 32,500; total loss about 151,000, EGI ≈ 1.049 million and a loss rate of 12.5%.
map.基准空置率办公 10%、住宅 5%、商业 8%；若空置率降 1%，年增收≈GPR: Benchmark vacancy is 10% for offices, 5% for housing and 8% for retail; cutting vacancy by 1% adds roughly GPR × 1% a year, about 12,000 in the example above.
map.EGI 和 NOI 区别？: How do EGI and NOI differ?
map.EGI=GPR−空置及信用损失+其他收入，NOI 再扣运营费用；EGI 看收租能: EGI = GPR − vacancy and credit losses + other income, while NOI then deducts operating expenses; EGI measures rent collection and NOI net operating performance.
map.基准空置率能改吗？: Can the benchmark vacancy rate be changed?
map.基准是经验值，应结合物业实际出租率与商圈空置调整，不能硬套。: It is a rule of thumb and should be tuned to the property's actual occupancy and district vacancy, not applied blindly.
map.房地产空置损失估算工具，依据潜在毛租金、空置率、收账损失率与让利比例，逐项分解损: A vacancy loss estimator: from GPR, vacancy rate, collection loss rate and concession ratio it breaks down each loss and computes EGI, benchmarked against vacancy norms for each property type.
map.空置/收账/让利损失分项: Separate vacancy, collection and concession losses
